```yaml
name: Android Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-android:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 8 (x64)
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '8'
          architecture: x64

      - name: Cache Maven dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-maven-

      - name: Setup workspace
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/setup-workspace.sh
          ./scripts/setup-workspace.sh -q -DskipTests -DskipArchetypeTests=true

      - name: Build Android port
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/build-android-port.sh
          source tools/env.sh
          ./scripts/build-android-port.sh -q -DskipTests -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true

      - name: Upload Android artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: android-artifacts
          path: |
            **/target/*.jar
            **/target/*.apk
```
